flows.name: Cold start, sign in, create a pod
Cold start, sign in, join an existing pod
Post a request and pod visibility
steps: From RelayBoard, tap post
Fill an optional note only, no PII fields exist
Submit shows awaitingConfirmation then honest 'Sent to N pod members' copy
A second seeded account on the same pod sees the request appear on its board and receives a push

flows.name: Two-account concurrent accept race
steps: Two seeded accounts both open the same open request
Both tap accept within a second of each other
One device latches to claimed/confirmed
The other device latches to already-covered-by-name with identical motion, no error styling

flows.name: Release and reopen
steps: The accepter opens a claimed request they accepted
Taps release
Request reopens and the pod is re-notified within ~30 seconds
Original requester and other pod members see the reopened state

flows.name: Requester withdraws an unclaimed request
steps: Requester opens their own still-open, unclaimed request
Taps withdraw
Request moves to the withdrawn terminal state, visually distinct from complete
No receipt is generated; pod is re-notified

flows.name: Unfulfilled request ages and is re-broadcast
steps: An open request passes its visible aging threshold with no acceptance
still-open state and copy render on both requester and pod member devices
Requester taps re-broadcast
Pod receives a fresh push and lastRebroadcastAt updates

flows.name: Completion produces a shared receipt
steps: Accepter marks the claimed request complete
Both requester and accepter can open the same Receipt
Requester shares the receipt via the system share sheet
Receipt survives even if one party later deletes their account, rendering that party as Former member

flows.name: Post a request and see honest delivery copy
Complete a claimed request and view the receipt
